title: Mick's 2017 Metabunk post calls the Dietrich account laughable
summary: Merrick von Renenamp tells of Mick's 2017 Metabunk post calls the Dietrich account laughable, about 2017 at Metabunk forum, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

plain: Merrick von Renenamp, speaking on a podcast, confronts Mick West, a skeptic who analyses UFO videos, with something West wrote on Metabunk, an online forum, on December 30, 2017. That post was a reaction to an interview released by To the Stars Academy, a company that put out UFO material, with Alex Dietrich, a Navy pilot who says she saw an unexplained object. Merrick says West called her account laughable, and he raises it to question how the skeptic treated a witness.
